description: 96 individually written fictional relation-level cases: 48 examples of a positive rhetorical opening immediately undercut by a demand/penalty, and 48 difficult negatives including respectful disagreement, unrelated content, legitimate deadlines, separate speakers and quoted examples. Smoke tests, not independent real-world accuracy.
